rationale: The 8.8 Premier aggregate Triage and Response row gives Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The detailed 8.8 task gives Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, enabled assistant and paired SOAR, requires existing AI-triaged findings and describes first-ten burst and about 200 findings per tenant/day, frontier models for Response and inherited connector/action/asset roles. The 8.7 task retains its distinct AI SOC Analyst terminology. The 8.8 page names both Triage and Response under the Premier workflow; it does not repeat the older broader Triage wording. November 4 ES 8.8 GA is product release evidence. The task identifies the CMP Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0 floors. The exact official indexed setup section additionally requires SAIA 2.4+ and Cloud Connect 2.0+. Direct setup retrieval returned 404. Current SAIA 2.3.6 still gives a Cloud Connected installation caution and points to planned 2.4.0. The documented 2.1.1 workaround has no Agent Mode. This does not confirm usable CMP workflow, exact SOAR pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement or customer authorization.

exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
